    Deck translations on linear module categories #

    Precomposition reverses the order of coherent endofunctor composition. We therefore first construct a shift by the additive opposite group and then reindex it along negation. The shift of a functor M in degree a is literally D.F (-a) ⋙ M.

    For a coherent left deck action, degree g on modules consequently has value M (g • X) at X. This is Gabriel's inverse module translate: if his translated module is written gM(X) = M(g⁻¹X), then Mathlib shift degree g is the module g⁻¹M.
